routes.name: Sohan - AOU

sources.title: Transit Map of Islamabad V-07 (CDA), legend
Transit Map of Islamabad V-08 (CDA, Oct 2025), legend

routes.notes: Legend text: 'Sohan to AOU via I8'. This route appears only in the legend of CDA transit maps V-07 and V-08. It is not in CDA's route table (cdaTransitMap, checked 2026-09-19), and there is no timetable PDF for it: FR-02_Forward.pdf and FR-02_Backward.pdf return 404. It may never have launched, or it may be planned. Stops are the two terminals as named in the legend; no stop list was found. Metrobus BLUE (PIMS - Gulberg) already serves Sohan and Kachnar Park I-8.

It is not in CDA's route table (cdaTransitMap, checked 2026-09-19), and there is no timetable PDF for it: FR-03B_Forward.pdf and FR-03B_Backward.pdf return 404. It may never have launched, or it may be planned. Stops are the two terminals as named in the legend; no stop list was found.

open_questions: Did FR-02 (Sohan - AOU) and FR-03B (PIMS - NL) ever launch? What does 'NL' stand for?

CDA's route table also lists FRB-01 (PIMS - Gulberg) and FRG-1 (PIMS - Barakahu), which are missing from islamabad-electric-feeder. Their timetable stop lists match metrobus BLUE and GREEN in data/systems/isb-rwp-metrobus.json, so they were not added here. The only difference is that the PIMS-bound direction adds PIMS Metro Station and Tipu Market G-8. Decide which system should own them.

The CDA table and maps label FR-05 'Golra Morh - Taxila', but the FR-05 timetable PDF runs NUST Metro Station - D-12, which matches our data. The map legend's FR-11 terminus is 'Foreign Office Society'; the table says I-16.
The CDA table gives FRB-01/FRG-1 hours as 08:00-19:00, but their PDFs start trips at 05:45.
